g.text: EleanorMonster begins.
Drifter. What you said yesterday. About letting the monster live. Did you mean it? I must know.
Of course, I meant it.
Honestly? I've thought about it some more. And, no. I'd have to stop you if you became a monster.
[Ignore.]
Not that I'm not exceedingly grateful and honestly a little shocked, but... why? WHY would you let me live? When everyone else here would be so willing to put a bullet through my head?
Thank you. You're an enigma to me in many ways, but now I know you'd be willing to put a bullet through my head, and that sort of thing is important in the workplace.
Chat ends.
The line between "hero" and "monster" is blurrier than most people like to admit. I've fought against Grineer and Corpus and fought alongside them.
Because I think you're one of the most fiercely intelligent, wonderfully sardonic people I've ever met. I don't even think the Techrot could take that away from you.
Aaaand I just felt the Techrot in my cells give an anxious little quiver.
I don't believe in the words "Good" and "Evil." Just people. Why do you have any less of a right to exist than I do? I might not have a Techrot tongue, but I'm just as much of a freak of nature.
How... beautifully naïve. And wonderfully sweet, in a tragic kind of way.
I think it's going to behave itself a little better from now on. Nothing like threatening the host to put the fear of Sol into the parasite, eh?
But here you are, battling away at the Scaldra and the Techrot, trying to find a way to stop the Indifference. You clearly believe there is some line to be drawn somewhere.
The fact that you believe I would come out the other side some manner of hive queen with my self intact, some bizarre voice of the infestation you could befriend or perhaps even adore.
Update boolean EleanorNoDate
The Indifference was unleashed by Entrati. A man. Human hubris was to blame for that.
Protecting people from death is not the same thing as believing something should be exterminated or has no right to exist.
I would chide you for the fact that the world does not function like a storybook, yet... I am reminded of precisely who you are and where you came from.
Chat ends.
But the Techrot is not the Indifference. What of that? What of the more biological, terrestrial threat?
Ensuring a flock of sheep doesn't get eaten by wolves is not the same as going out and murdering all the wolves for being evil.
So I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
We don't really know where the Techrot came from. It could be manmade. It could be from something else entirely.
The simple fact is, you don't want me to kill you. So I wouldn't. I'd let you go.
And what if nothing of Eleanor remained? What if you saw nothing but a hissing, snarling, spitting beast?
Either way, I guess I am grateful you wouldn't kill me. There's that. At least.
And if the Techrot turned out to be another man-unleashed aberration like your Man in the Wall? What then? Would you hunt me down and kill me?
While I'm grateful that you would abide by a monstrous lady's wishes, I suppose was hoping for something a bit more... considered.
How do I know nothing of Eleanor remained? You talk about how the Techrot thinks. How it talks to you. It's clearly intelligent.
Chat ends.
No. I couldn't.
Yes. If the Techrot really is unnatural? Then... it has to go.
+5 Chemistry
It seems to be a hive mind. Maybe Eleanor would still be in there, not in one place, but a billion. Who am I to say that's "wrong?"
You're contradicting yourself. If you're willing to stop one manmade aberration, why not two?
Thank you. You're an enigma to me in many ways, but now I know you'd be willing to put a bullet through my head, and that sort of thing is important in the workplace.
Either way, I guess I am grateful you wouldn't kill me. There's that. At least.
Just when I simply thought I could not adore you more I find myself once more sitting here crying happy tears
Because I have feelings for you. [Confess feelings.]
Because you mean too much to me as a friend.
Aaaand I just felt the Techrot in my cells give an anxious little quiver.
Chat ends.
+20 Chemistry
Asking me if I'd kill you is just *cruel,* Eleanor. When the thought of you dead, or in pain, just --
Asking me if I'd kill you is just *cruel,* Eleanor. You're my friend. You're like family to me.
I think it's going to behave itself a little better from now on. Nothing like threatening the host to put the fear of Sol into the parasite, eh?
I have to go but thank you thank you THANK YOU
The fact of the matter is? No. I couldn't. Because the hope that you'd exist somewhere out there? In some form? Anywhere? Would be enough for me.
The fact of the matter is? No. I couldn't. Because the hope that you'd exist somewhere out there? In some form? Anywhere? Would be enough for me.
Update boolean EleanorNoDate
Chat ends.
I'm sorry. I can't do this. I need to go.
I'm sorry. I can't do this. I need to go.
Chat ends.
Update boolean EleanorConfession
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
Oh, Eleanor, you stepped in it this time...
Oh... oh, what have I done...
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
